name: PRICE_RETURN_5_CONTROL
scientific_rationale: Short-horizon price-move control isolates the price component.
known_limitation: Not a CSRS rank and may contain reversal or continuation behavior.

name: PRICE_RETURN_20_CONTROL
scientific_rationale: One-month price-move control isolates the price component.
known_limitation: Not a CSRS rank and may contain reversal or continuation behavior.

name: LOG_VOLUME_SURPRISE_20_CONTROL
scientific_rationale: Log scaling controls the extreme right tail while retaining abnormal-volume ordering.
known_limitation: Volume alone has no price direction and corporate actions can disturb the baseline.

name: LOG_VOLUME_SURPRISE_60_CONTROL
scientific_rationale: A longer prior-only baseline tests slower volume normalization without adding more horizons.
known_limitation: Highly correlated with the 20-session volume control.

name: PRICE5_X_HIGH_VOLUME20
scientific_rationale: Tests whether above-baseline volume amplifies the magnitude and direction of a short price move.
known_limitation: Multiplication can remain heavy-tailed and zeroes below-baseline volume intensity.

name: PRICE20_X_HIGH_VOLUME20
scientific_rationale: Tests abnormal volume as an amplifier of a one-month price move.
known_limitation: Price and volume windows overlap and the product can remain heavy-tailed.

name: SIGNED_HIGH_VOLUME20_60
scientific_rationale: Longer-window directional abnormal volume contrasts with the short interaction.
known_limitation: Discards price-move magnitude and uses a highly persistent volume baseline.
